name: diagrams
description_en: :art: Diagram as Code for prototyping cloud system architectures
readme_excerpt: Diagrams Diagram as Code. Diagrams lets you draw the cloud system architecture in Python code. It was born for prototyping a new system architecture design without any design tools. You can also describe or visualize the existing system architecture as well. Diagrams currently supports main major providers including: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Alibaba Cloud, Oracle Cloud etc...
